notes:
Describes something or someone positioned between two things, acting as an intermediary or intervening force. Often used in formal writing and news to describe hidden factors or middlemen in a situation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{第三者|だいさんしゃ}→第三者：26789_daisansha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{介在|かいざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a third party intervenes
- ⟦{利害|りがい}→利害：04091_rigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{介在|かいざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: interests are involved
- ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{介在|かいざい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: emotions come into play
- ⟦{仲介者|ちゅうかいしゃ}→仲介者：23919_chuukaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{介在|かいざい}: involvement of a mediator

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧: mediation, brokerage — focuses on actively facilitating between parties
- ⟦{介入|かいにゅう}→介入：07425_kainyuu⟧: intervention — implies more forceful or deliberate involvement
